results.title: Kiwi.com is rated "Great" with 4 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Considering 31,229 reviews, reviewers had a great experience with this company. Many consumers frequently highlight how simple and straightforward it is to search for affordable flights, compare different available options, and successfully manage their holiday travel bookings quite smoothly. Travelers also genuinely appreciate consistently finding very competitive ticket prices and receiving prom pt, up-to-date flight notifications throughout the entire journey. However, some people mentioned experiencing frustrating delays in receiving essential booking confirmations and necessary airline boarding passes on time before departure.
